sampling: Four deterministic rounds through the four critical train-only pools; choose a previously unused image each time. No selection by model error. Same shuffled two-batch cycles for both arms.
loss: Unchanged raw-metre Huber delta 0.2: 0.8 equal four-cell near objective plus 0.2 broad, equal images within each component.
initialization: Both arms restart from the reviewed epoch-7 base and the same freshly seeded zero-output camera adapter; do not reuse the jointly trained adapter.
protection: Only 1553 adapter parameters enter AdamW. Existing depth parameters, BN affine weights and BN running statistics are all frozen. Urban features are frozen and cached once.
scope: Deliberate tiny-training-set fit check, not generalization evidence or a product threshold. 300 updates equal 150 passes over 16 images, not 150 full-dataset epochs.
